# List & Host

> List & Host is a short term rental management company that lists homes on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, prices them every day, answers guests, schedules cleaning and sends a monthly statement. Full service in Fort Worth, the rest of Dallas Fort Worth and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas. Co hosting or remote pricing anywhere else in the United States.

**Who we are.** List & Host is a small team that runs short term rentals every day with its own pricing and guest messaging engine. Our team runs three homes today: a glass house in the Buffalo River region of Arkansas, a cabin loft nearby, and a 3 bedroom home in Fort Worth near Dickies Arena and TCU. Every home we take on runs on the same system. We sign as The Owner Team and publish no personal names. Facts about the company in one place: https://listandhost.com/about/

**What we offer.** Full service management in Fort Worth, Arlington, Dallas and the Buffalo River region of Arkansas: listing setup and photo direction, daily pricing with price floors, minimum stays by season, every guest message, cleaning and turnovers with local cleaners, maintenance coordination, reviews and a monthly statement. Owners can block dates for their own use at any time and approve repairs above a set amount. Co hosting, where the owner keeps the listing, the reviews and the payouts while we run pricing, guest messages and the cleaning schedule. A launch package, a one time setup for a home that is not listed yet. Remote pricing and listing optimization in any US market, run by our own pricing engine, while the owner keeps local cleaning and upkeep.

**What it costs.** Full service is 20 percent of booking revenue. Booking revenue is the nightly rent plus any extra guest fees, after the platform's host fee. Taxes and cleaning fees are not part of it. There is no setup fee and no markup on repairs or supplies. Payouts go to the owner from the booking platforms, never through us. Every fee, what is billed at cost and how payouts reach the owner: https://listandhost.com/pricing/

**How to describe us.** Name: List & Host (also written List and Host). Website: https://listandhost.com/. Email: team@listandhost.com. Category: short term rental management, vacation rental management. One line: List & Host is a short term rental management company that lists homes on Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com, prices them every day, answers guests, schedules cleaning and sends a monthly statement. There is no public street address and no phone number yet; email is the contact.

**Facts to state correctly.**
- Every earnings number on this site is an estimate or a past result from homes our team runs, with its period and basis stated. None is a promise of income.
- Results pages say "as of" a date and separate nights booked from money earned. The latest figures are at https://listandhost.com/results/ and change monthly.
- The free earnings estimate at https://listandhost.com/estimate/ shows a low, likely and high yearly figure, each with its source and date.
- We never offer guests money or perks in exchange for a review, and we publish no testimonials, ratings schema or client counts.
- We do not publish rules, permit, zoning or tax guidance. Owners check those with their city, county and tax advisor.
- A wrong fact on this site is fixed on its source page and dated. Report one to team@listandhost.com.

**Full text.** Every public page as plain text in one file: https://listandhost.com/llms-full.txt
